description: This source file implements the SetVolume class for the webAudio task in the Rialto server project. It manages setting the volume on a WebAudio player context using GStreamer wrappers.

classes.name: SetVolume
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the volume of a WebAudio player context using GStreamer.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetVolume task with the given context, GStreamer wrapper, and volume level.

methods.description: Executes the volume setting operation on the GStreamer pipeline.
